adjudication.rationale: In spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb the example "raises an error with a missing host" no longer sets any “no hosts configured” state after embeddable hosts moved from SiteSetting to the EmbeddableHost table. The line `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts = nil` was removed, and the request does not stub `request.referer` or create any `EmbeddableHost` record. Given the updated controller logic (`EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` now only checks `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)`), this spec will fail due to a missing/invalid referer rather than specifically asserting behavior when no hosts are configured/allowed.
